39	// AllowAnonymous reports whether unauthenticated visitors may access the instance.
40	//
41	// Anonymous access is enabled only when an InstanceURL is configured. An instance
42	// with no InstanceURL set is treated as private: anonymous callers are limited to
43	// the auth-bootstrap endpoints (sign-in, share links, etc.) and the web UI redirects
44	// them to the sign-in page instead of the public Explore view. Authenticated callers
45	// (session, access token, or personal access token) are never affected.
46	func (p *Profile) AllowAnonymous() bool {
47		return strings.TrimSpace(p.InstanceURL) != ""
48	}

50	func checkDataDir(dataDir string) (string, error) {
51		// Convert to absolute path if relative path is supplied.
52		if !filepath.IsAbs(dataDir) {
53			// Use current working directory, not the binary's directory
54			// This ensures we use the actual working directory where the process runs
55			absDir, err := filepath.Abs(dataDir)
56			if err != nil {
57				return "", err
58			}
59			dataDir = absDir
60		}
61	
62		// Trim trailing \ or / in case user supplies
63		dataDir = strings.TrimRight(dataDir, "\\/")
64		if _, err := os.Stat(dataDir); err != nil {
65			return "", errors.Wrapf(err, "unable to access data folder %s", dataDir)
66		}
67		return dataDir, nil
68	}
69	
70	func (p *Profile) Validate() error {
71		// Set default data directory if not specified
72		if p.Data == "" {
73			if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
74				p.Data = filepath.Join(os.Getenv("ProgramData"), "memos")
75			} else {
76				// On Linux/macOS, check if /var/opt/memos exists and is writable (Docker scenario)
77				if info, err := os.Stat("/var/opt/memos"); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
78					// Check if we can write to this directory
79					testFile := filepath.Join("/var/opt/memos", ".write-test")
80					if err := os.WriteFile(testFile, []byte("test"), 0600); err == nil {
81						os.Remove(testFile)
82						p.Data = "/var/opt/memos"
83					} else {
84						// /var/opt/memos exists but is not writable, use current directory
85						slog.Warn("/var/opt/memos is not writable, using current directory")
86						p.Data = "."
87					}
88				} else {
89					// /var/opt/memos doesn't exist, use current directory (local development)
90					p.Data = "."
91				}
92			}
93		}
94	
95		// Create data directory if it doesn't exist
96		if _, err := os.Stat(p.Data); os.IsNotExist(err) {
97			if err := os.MkdirAll(p.Data, 0770); err != nil {
98				slog.Error("failed to create data directory", slog.String("data", p.Data), slog.String("error", err.Error()))
99				return err
100			}
101		}
102	
103		dataDir, err := checkDataDir(p.Data)
104		if err != nil {
105			slog.Error("failed to check dsn", slog.String("data", dataDir), slog.String("error", err.Error()))
106			return err
107		}
108	
109		p.Data = dataDir
110		if p.Driver == "sqlite" && p.DSN == "" {
111			mode := "prod"
112			if p.Demo {
113				mode = "demo"
114			}
115			dbFile := fmt.Sprintf("memos_%s.db", mode)
116			p.DSN = filepath.Join(dataDir, dbFile)
117		}
118	
119		return nil
120	}

156			}
157		}
